title: Protection paladin: picks up a second mob that joins mid-fight

rules.desc: A mob that hits the healer (extra1) or the DPS player gets Hand of Reckoning (or Righteous Defense) on it within 5 s, at least 70 percent of the time (one trigger per mob per 12 s, one counted answer per 10 s: Hand of Reckoning's cooldown). A scheduled second mob joins about a minute in (refill_every_s 60) while the first still lives, so its triggers arrive while the single-target taunt may be on cooldown from the first mob Only hits after 55 s count (trigger t_from 55): the scheduled refill_every_s 60 add lands about a minute into the fight, so earlier hits on the first mob are not triggers.
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/ProtectionPaladinStrategy.cpp:51-60 (lose aggro -> hand of reckoning and party member attacked -> hand of reckoning on attacker, both at ACTION_MOVE, #1156); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the scheduled add opens on the player while the first mob still lives; both reckoning rows sit at ACTION_MOVE, so whether the paladin answers the add while already tanking is the question. Expected UNKNOWN on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: No Drink cast by the bot starts while a mob is on the player or the healer (extra1): the meal's cast-time race. DrinkAction::isUseful already requires !GroupIsFighting, so this is a precondition/regression guard, not the meal-gap grader: a refill mob that opens on a party member DURING the meal is what the add-pickup misses show, and this rule stays 0 there. Counted per repeat and pooled over the repeats: pass only when no repeat has a single such cast. A cast whose attack state cannot be read (a mob live at the cast with no deciding attack packet and no fresh sample) is INCONCLUSIVE for that repeat, never a pass.
rules.source: precondition/regression guard for the meal cast; ai/playerbot/strategy/actions/UseItemAction.h:692-772 (DrinkAction: isUseful requires !GroupIsFighting, SetDuration(drinkDuration) puts the AI to sleep for the meal); paladin-addpickup WHY.md 2026-11-12 (12 of 15 add-pickup misses come 1.6-15 s after a Drink started, the mobs arriving during the meal)
rules.why_expect: DrinkAction::isUseful() needs !GroupIsFighting(ai) and isPossible() needs the bot out of combat (UseItemAction.h:761-772 at upstream/dev abb91ff62), so a cast while a mob is on the player or the healer is a stale-value race. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev f7368050d; the six images in paladin-addpickup WHY.md (2026-11-12) all rescore 0.

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
